name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and pick it up. Then open the locked door, enter the room, and pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the hard goal, and the Precedence chain (room before pickup, door before room, key before door, key_found before key) captures the stated order 'first find the key and pick it up, then open the locked door, enter the room, and pick up the ball'. The chain with the final Existence forces every earlier step, so no additional Existence clauses are needed.

Open the locked door before entering the target room
Pick up the matching key before opening the locked door
Find the key before picking it up
